items.headline: Strong Run into Knockout Stage
items.body: Brazil has shown strong form leading into the Round of 16, securing five wins and one draw in their last six matches, scoring 17 goals and conceding only 5. This impressive run includes comfortable victories over Haiti and Scotland in the group stage.

items.headline: Group C Winners
items.body: Brazil topped Group C, advancing to the Round of 32 after a draw against Morocco and decisive wins over Haiti and Scotland. They then secured a hard-fought 2-1 victory against Japan in the Round of 32, with Gabriel Martinelli scoring a late winner.

items.headline: Paquetá Out with Hamstring Injury
items.body: Midfielder Lucas Paquetá suffered a grade two hamstring strain during the Round of 32 match against Japan and is expected to miss at least three weeks, potentially ruling him out for the remainder of the tournament. He was substituted at halftime in the 2-1 victory.

items.headline: Wesley Replaced by Éderson
items.body: Right-back Wesley was ruled out of the World Cup due to a left thigh muscle injury sustained in a friendly against Egypt on June 6, 2026. Midfielder Éderson was called up as his replacement in the 26-player squad.

items.headline: Ancelotti's Adaptability Tested
items.body: Under coach Carlo Ancelotti, Brazil has demonstrated resilience, particularly in their comeback win against Japan. The recent injuries, especially to Paquetá, will test the squad's depth and Ancelotti's tactical adjustments in the midfield.

items.headline: Brazil vs Norway in Last 16
items.body: Brazil will face Norway in the Round of 16 on July 5, 2026, at MetLife Stadium. This will be a challenging encounter against a Norway side that has shown competitive form in the tournament.

metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey
